sql: SELECT coalesce(p.series_ticker,'-') AS series, left(coalesce(p.market_title,'-'),42) AS title, count(*)::text AS markets, min(p.target_size)::text AS tgt_min, max(p.target_size)::text AS tgt_max, min(p.discount_factor_bps)::text AS disc_min, max(p.discount_factor_bps)::text AS disc_max, round(sum(p.period_reward_usd),2)::text AS reward_sum FROM incentive_programs p WHERE p.superseded_at IS NULL AND p.disappeared_at IS NULL AND (p.market_title ILIKE '%Grand Theft Auto%' OR p.market_title ILIKE '%Red Rocks%' OR p.market_title ILIKE '%Boston Calling%' OR p.market_title ILIKE '%Halftime%' OR p.market_title ILIKE '%aerospace%' OR p.market_title ILIKE '%Playoff%') GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY series, title LIMIT 30
